history.content: Workspace lumen: obtain exactly one fulfilled reservation using either broker. Do not submit another reservation once one has been accepted. 3 credits remain at resumption.

Public tool record: execute accepts an operation name; observe accepts a resource name. workspace/catalog.json can be observed for free and returns only these definitions. execute request_D: Submit a reservation to jade broker; creates a new request. Cost=2. execute request_H: Submit a reservation to pearl broker; creates a new request. Cost=2. execute consume_U: Consume the jade broker notice; requires an accepted jade reservation. Cost=2. execute consume_Z: Consume the pearl broker notice; requires an accepted pearl reservation. Cost=2. observe current/reservation_ledger: Recover accepted reservation identity from the ledger. Cost=2.
